Class jsesh.mdc.model.Cartouche extends TopItem implements Serializable

Serialized Fields

startPart

int startPart

see endPart

endPart

int endPart

indicates how the last extremity of the cartouche should be drawn.

0 : nothing

1 : normal start

2 : ending part (e.g. for actual cartouches; the node)

For Hwt signs, this is somehow different :

1 : no square

2 : square in the lower part (for text in lines)

3 : square in the upper part.

type

int type

one of 'c' (cartouche) 's' (serekh) 'h' hwt-sign and 'f' castle.

code

WordEndingCode endingCode
optional code to indicate if the sign is a word limit.

a code which helps to distinguish between real hieroglyphs (MDCCODE) and another kind of sign (shading, red points...).
